description.value: Sushi Musa appears in OSM as a Japanese/sushi restaurant in a Langley strip mall, but its website now promotes Korean food and lists a Vancouver address, suggesting the business may have relocated, rebranded, or closed at this location. The website advertises online ordering for Korean dishes including fried chicken, kimchi rice, and Korean sausage. The mismatch between the OSM record and the current website makes the status of the Langley location unclear.
